title: Encoding a zone word
statement: Given a side and a word whose entries are either absent or Boolean values, encode each entry by two bits. For the right side, the pair records first whether the entry is present and then its value, taking an absent value to be false; for the other side, record the value first and presence second. Concatenate these pairs in the original order.
hypotheses_covered: A finite list of optional Boolean values
